# [Thalia Agent](https://github.com/cyberstar-btw/thalia-agent)

Thalia Agent is a planned open-source assistant by [cyberstar-btw](https://github.com/cyberstar-btw) for B2B proposal follow-up. The agent has not been built and its source code has not been published.

## Planned purpose

- Find sent B2B proposal conversations that may need follow-up.
- Let a person review and classify each candidate.
- Prepare a draft for the person to review and send themselves.

## Current status

The project website is being prepared. Email integration, message sending, and the agent are not available.
